comments.comment: To add to that, only women’s health is considered an issue for late year pregnancies whereas the more dangerous caveat is male sperm quality which also declines with age. It’s worth noting that only one gender is given the pressure to concieve early while the other is lied to regarding the time they have to concieve healthy children. All the more adding to the need for choice in decisions of pregnancy at all stages.
